summary: The local RCA task workspace itself has zero commits, but the real deliverable is FChecklist/compliance-tracker PR #581, which the supervisor correctly adopted after fixing a branch-resolution bug (a prior automated review pass wrongly rejected this PR based on a stale empty diff -- that verdict should be disregarded). PR #581 is genuine, well-researched docs-only work: a new ai-os/V2-12_SERVERLESS_RESOURCE_LIMITS.md documenting live Vercel Hobby-plan serverless limits and auditing five specific HIGH-severity N+1 database-call patterns across payroll/report/bulk-op routes with file-level citations, correctly indexed in ai-os/OS.yaml, plus a plan re-score in SUPERBOSS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_2026-07-19_v2.md and a claim entry in ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml. Only docs/metadata files are touched -- no schema, auth, payment, billing, RLS, or .github/workflows/** changes -- correctly classified tier1. All required CI checks pass (Lint, Type Check, Build, Unit Tests, E2E Tests, audit-check, Guardrail/Asset Registry checks); the sole failing check (Metadata Index Coverage) is non-required and verified pre-existing on main (56 unrelated legacy files, none touched by this PR). Recommend approval, with the caveat that the branch currently shows a real merge conflict against main and will need a rebase before an autonomous merge can succeed.
issues: GitHub reports mergeable=CONFLICTING / mergeStateStatus=DIRTY for PR #581 against main -- an autonomous `gh pr merge` will fail until the branch is rebased; this is a mechanical blocker, not a defect in the content, but must be resolved (rebase + re-check) before merge can complete

A prior automated Superboss review pass on this same task produced a reject verdict based on a stale/empty diff (reviewing the local RCA scaffold workspace rather than PR #581's real branch) -- that verdict is superseded by this review and should not be relied on; the underlying branch-resolution tooling bug that caused it appears to have been fixed per task.yaml's branch_correction_note, but is worth a follow-up check that it doesn't recur on other tasks
